title: tc-tag-input
description: A field of free-text chips with suggestions, limits and validation.

value.description: The tags. Changed by the user unless a tc-value-change listener calls preventDefault()

suggestions.description: Offered in a list under the field, filtered by what's typed

allowCustom.description: Accept tags that aren't in `suggestions`; set allow-custom="false" to allow only suggestions

max.description: The most tags the field holds

unique.description: Refuse a tag that's already there (ignoring case); set unique="false" to allow repeats

label.description: Visible label above the field (or use a page <label for>)

name.description: Submitted with the form: one entry per tag

disabled.description: Can't be changed or focused; also disabled inside a disabled <fieldset>

required.description: At least one tag before the form submits
